name: Smart Dialer v1.0.47
body: Moved IP Call Sound & Audio Quality inside IP Calling & IP Number Settings. Added full-app dynamic theming with instant live preview. Added animated caller skins for all themes (iOS frosted breathing glow, Samsung concentric wave ripples, Cyberpunk AMOLED rotating neon & equalizer, Emerald living Aurora, Sunset Velvet heartbeat pulse, and Classic Dark radar sonar).
